description: This Java source file defines the AttributeNotAccessibleException class, a custom exception used within the Eclipse Ditto framework to indicate that an attribute of a 'thing' could not be accessed due to being missing or insufficient permissions. It includes methods for creating instances from messages or JSON, and a builder class for constructing exceptions with detailed context.

classes.name: AttributeNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception when an attribute on a 'thing' is not accessible, either because it does not exist or due to permission issues. It provides static methods for creation from messages or JSON and uses a builder pattern for detailed construction.

classes.name: AttributeNotAccessibleException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for AttributeNotAccessibleException enabling fluent construction with customizable message, description, cause, headers, and hyperlink.

methods.name: AttributeNotAccessibleException.fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance with a custom message and headers.

methods.name: AttributeNotAccessibleException.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance by parsing error details from a JSON object.

methods.name: AttributeNotAccessibleException.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated DittoHeaders.
